lines.en: departs from the sign of a mansion, the visibility of that mansion, which is that same sign, before the sunrise in the east

lines.text: ظاهر شود انظهور را چون ظهور باقی ثوابت را طلوع گویند و طلوع هر منزلی که در موسم مطر بود
lines.en: becomes apparent, that appearance, like the appearance of the rest of the fixed stars, they call rising, and the rising of any mansion that is in the season of rain

lines.text: عرب انرا نوء گوید و طلوع آن باقی را باوج و با طلوع هر منزلی سقوط پانزدهم آن منزل باشد
lines.en: the Arabs call it naw', and the rising of the rest of it with the apogee, and with the rising of each mansion is the setting of the fifteenth of that mansion

summary.headline: Rising and Setting of Mansions
summary.text: Instructions for recording the Moon’s daily transfers between lunar mansions by mansion, hour, minute, and day or night, including cases of multiple or empty entries. Explains the Sun’s crossing of the mansions (signs), their rising and setting, the Arabic term nawʾ, and how these phenomena are recorded in almanacs alongside planetary aspects.
